Bringing your own phone has never been easier.
Choose a plan that works for you.
All Mobility plans come with 5G speed, unlimited Canada-wide minutes, unlimited international SMS and your choice of perk.
Keep your number.
Transfer your existing number to Koodo. Don't cancel your current plan, we'll do that for you. You can also choose to get a new number during your purchase.
Connect instantly with eSIM.
Bring your eSIM compatible device for instant activation. Or, get a SIM card shipped in 5-10 business days. $15 SIM purchase required.
LOOKING FOR A NEW PHONE?
Get the phone you want on the terms that are right for you.
Need a phone with no hidden fees and no fixed-term contracts? Get it with the Tab. Eligible phones get a Tab Bonus for more savings.

©2026 Koodo Mobile.

Koodo and our partners use cookies to enhance website navigation, analyze website usage, and provide relevant advertising and personalized content, including on third party websites. You have control over these cookies, and can choose to "Accept all cookies", adjust your preferences by clicking "Manage cookies", or if you're happy with the selection that we have made for you, simply click on "x". Blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer. To learn more about how we and third parties use your data, read our Cookie Statement and our Privacy Commitment.
